The '''Moon Islands''' were a series of seven [[Island/Legends|islands]] that were located in the [[Moon Channel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The Islands were spread across one hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] between the continents of [[Kato Zakar]] and [[Talss]]. [[Ban Landing]] and a similar port [[City/Legends|city]] on Talss sent regular [[Starship/Legends|ships]] across the channel at scheduled intervals.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Moon Islands were first mentioned in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'',<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void" /> a [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[Book|novel]] written by [[Tim Lebbon]],<ref name="DOTJITV Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/222802/into-the-void-star-wars-legends-dawn-of-the-jedi-by-tim-lebbon/9780345541932|text=Into the Void: Star Wars Legends (Dawn of the Jedi)}}</ref> and the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void (audiobook)|respective audiobook of the same name]].<ref name="DOTJITV audiobook">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void (audiobook)|''Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void'' audiobook]]</ref>
